name: Decibel
tagline: Turn listener patterns into enterprise sponsorship
prompt: An analytics workspace for independent podcast creators: listener growth, episode retention and sponsorship revenue

spec.name: Decibel
spec.world: The network 'Deep Dive Media' runs three core shows: 'Tech Horizon' (hosted by Maya Lin, 42.8k subscribers), 'The Blueprint' (hosted by Marcus Vance, 118.4k subscribers), and 'Future Retro' (hosted by Leo Sterling, 18.2k subscribers). Sponsorship contracts include Q2 run-of-network ads for 'Linear Logistics' at $22,400 with a committed CPM of $28.00, and mid-roll integrations for 'Retool Inc' at $15,800. Episode 184 'The API Economy' has an average drop-off point at 18 minutes 24 seconds (42% mark).

imagery.subject: A minimal, high-contrast dark-mode interface showing an audio waveform graph layered with neon green and purple retention bands, illustrating listener drop-off levels.
A crisp, multi-page PDF media kit layout presenting high-level statistics for 'The Blueprint' podcast with sharp gridlines and large numerals.
An abstract, close-up photograph of professional microphone diaphragms and sound-dampening architectural acoustic panels in a sterile gray studio.
A dense data visualization showing concentric circular charts tracking listener overlaps and subscriber migration paths between different network shows.

spec.summary: An analytics and inventory platform built specifically for independent podcast networks to understand listener retention, track cross-platform growth, and pitch sponsors with real-time performance metrics.
spec.tagline: Turn listener patterns into enterprise sponsorship
spec.audience: Independent podcast networks, audio creators, and boutique show producers

directions.why: Independent networks need toolsets that feel incredibly precise, secure, and ready to stand up against enterprise ad-buyer scrutiny.
directions.twist: A high-fidelity layout emphasizing dark mode obsidian surfaces, lime-green audio accent bars, and real-time integration status badges with Spotify and Apple Developer APIs.

directions.why: Emphasizes absolute data clarity, logical layout hierarchies, and dense, raw numbers that look like high-performance engineering tools.
directions.twist: Monochrome gray panels, micro-borders with a 1px solid black grid, absolute reliance on monospace typography for all audio timestamps (e.g. 18:24.03), and massive red status indicators.

directions.why: Podcast creators are storytellers first. An editorial layout makes audio data feel like a digital editorial zine, appealing to craft-oriented creators.
directions.twist: Off-white cream backgrounds, warm-toned dark-sepia text, large serif typography, and elegant, generous margins that treat sponsorship metrics like an annual studio report.

spec.heroObject: The absolute reach and blended listener retention metrics across Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and YouTube

directions.why: Independent networks need toolsets that feel incredibly precise, secure, and ready to stand up against enterprise ad-buyer scrutiny.
directions.name: Obsidian Precision
directions.pitch: A high-fidelity developer-grade analytics dashboard that uses deep obsidian surfaces and lime-green audio waves to turn raw listener logs into bulletproof enterprise metrics.
directions.twist: A high-fidelity layout emphasizing dark mode obsidian surfaces, lime-green audio accent bars, and real-time integration status badges with Spotify and Apple Developer APIs.
directions.motion: Fast, high-fidelity state changes (120ms ease-out) with zero spring physics, optimizing for dense data navigation and instant filtering feedback.
directions.imagery: No photography. The product UI itself serves as the graphic content, utilizing dense, crisp wireframe-style audio waveforms, modular line charts with single-pixel tracking nodes, and micro api-connection status badges.
signature: Interactive audio scrubber overlay displaying real-time drop-off curves on hovered timestamps
Verified platform connection indicators showcasing green heartbeat sync status next to Apple and Spotify logos
Micro tabular metrics showing delta percentages inside thin, subtle borders directly inside list rows

directions.why: Emphasizes absolute data clarity, logical layout hierarchies, and dense, raw numbers that look like high-performance engineering tools.
directions.name: Helvetica Signal
directions.pitch: A hard-grid, ultra-rational interface built with strict black borders, razor-sharp alignment, and Swiss red signal highlights for undeniable proof-of-performance metrics.
directions.twist: Monochrome gray panels, micro-borders with a 1px solid black grid, absolute reliance on monospace typography for all audio timestamps (e.g. 18:24.03), and massive red status indicators.
directions.motion: Mechanical, instant transitions (150ms ease-out) sliding linearly along the vertical grid lines, avoiding any organic or physics-based easing.
directions.imagery: Completely sparse. Pure data structures, heavily ruled tables, and hard cropping of dynamic elements. High contrast black-and-white podcast cover thumbnails when imagery is essential.
signature: Oversized 72px monospace drop-off timestamps aligned flush left on a vertical grid line
Bold 2px black rules dividing major content zones with red status pills acting as visual anchors
Data table row inversions (turns solid black with white text) on user pointer hover

signature: A wide marginalia sidebar on desktop containing auxiliary episode notes and credits written in muted sans-serif type
Inline text annotations inside analytics charts detailing the specific editorial moments behind listener retention spikes
Deep crimson 1px underlined links with generous letter spacing to evoke old literary reviews
